title: Trust Vault page loads at /trust-vault with the Certifications tab active by default
preconditions: Logged in as a user with trust_vault.read
expectedResult: The page loads without a console error or blank screen; the Certifications tab is selected and either a certification list or an appropriate empty state renders.

title: Upload Certification modal opens and blocks submit when required fields are empty
steps: Leave Title, Framework, and Issue/Expiry Date empty
expectedResult: The modal opens without error, the Save action is blocked or shows required-field validation, and no certification is created.

title: Vault Health widget renders a score and grade for a brand-new, empty vault without crashing
preconditions: A freshly onboarded org/project with zero certifications, reports, and incidents
steps: Navigate to /trust-vault and view the Vault Health widget
expectedResult: The widget renders a numeric score and letter grade (expected low/F given zero data) without throwing, and shows a 'No active certifications' style recommendation rather than an error state.

title: Expiry Dashboard loads and toggles between the Certifications and Reports pills without error
steps: Open the Expiry sub-tab of Trust Vault
Click the 'Reports' pill, then click 'Certs' again
expectedResult: Both toggles complete without a loading spinner hang or console error; the table columns switch appropriately (Framework column for certs, Type column for reports).

title: My Reviews tab shows the correct empty-state message when nothing is assigned to the current user
preconditions: The logged-in user has no certifications or reports currently assigned to them for review
expectedResult: The table renders the empty-state message 'No reviews assigned. Items assigned to you for review will appear here.' with no rows and no error toast.
